description: This file contains calculation functions for processing card data, including statistical computations like sum, average, median, min, max, and date range, as well as property value counts and percentages, used within a larger project related to a card-based data management system.

methods.name: getCardProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value from a card, handling different property types and IDs.

methods.name: fixTimestampToMinutesAccuracy
methods.description: Adjusts a timestamp to minute-level accuracy by removing seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: cardsWithValue
methods.description: Filters cards that have a non-empty value for a given property.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of cards.

methods.name: countEmpty
methods.description: Counts cards with empty or null property values.

methods.name: countNotEmpty
methods.description: Counts cards with non-empty property values.

methods.name: percentEmpty
methods.description: Calculates percentage of cards with empty property values.

methods.name: percentNotEmpty
methods.description: Calculates percentage of cards with non-empty property values.

methods.name: countValueHelper
methods.description: Helper to count total values, considering multi-select properties.

methods.name: countValue
methods.description: Counts total property values across cards.

methods.name: countChecked
methods.description: Counts checked items for a property.

methods.name: countUnchecked
methods.description: Counts unchecked items for a property.

methods.name: percentChecked
methods.description: Calculates percentage of checked items.

methods.name: percentUnchecked
methods.description: Calculates percentage of unchecked items.

methods.name: countUniqueValue
methods.description: Counts unique property values across cards.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of numeric property values.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the average of numeric property values.

methods.name: median
methods.description: Calculates the median of numeric property values.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Finds the minimum value among property values.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Finds the maximum value among property values.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Returns a string representing the range between min and max values.

methods.name: earliest
methods.description: Finds the earliest date/time among cards for a date property.

methods.name: earliestEpoch
methods.description: Gets the earliest timestamp among cards.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Finds the latest date/time among cards for a date property.

methods.name: latestEpoch
methods.description: Gets the latest timestamp among cards.

methods.name: getTimestampsFromPropertyValue
methods.description: Extracts timestamps from property values, handling different formats.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Calculates human-readable duration between earliest and latest dates.
